## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 30, 2026 - Aug 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tom Moore_, Aug 1, 2026, 1/5: "I think this app and company are fraudsters. Beware! I paid for the trial, never received the plan, then couldn't cancel without a lot of lies and trouble. Before you sign up, check to see how to cancel. In my experience this app should be called the "Hotel California" health app: you can (try to) check out, but you can never leave. Buyer beware."
            2. _Sean Grantom_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up for the trial. I immediately opened up the subscription and clicked cancel to stop the auto-renewal so I could just evaluate the app. Then I got busy and couldn't even try it within my trial period. Only for the app to automatically charge me ¥7000 because on the cancellation screen you have to click cancel 4-5 times before it will cancel. It was eventually refunded after multiple chats, but left a bad taste regarding ethical business practices."
            3. _Darren Cresswell_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "absolutely disgusting , I canceled my subscription and received confirmation from BetterMe , they debited me anyway and when requesting a refund they say you have to cancel in google play as well even after saying in the confirmation email you should not receive another debit , nothing to say you must cancel elsewhere as well , very very disappointing and shocking really"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 23, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Sabina Kotiranta_, May 23, 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            2. _Dana Krebs_, Aug 6, 2026, 2/5: "I gave this app a 2 because it takes multiple attempts to open the app. It crashes all the time. I have a plan I paid for and I like the exercises within the app. If I had not already paid for a plan I would had already gotten rid of this app. So before getting a plan I would read multiple reviews. Only reason I gave it 2 stars is because I am enjoying the exercises once I able to get in the app and keep it open long enough to do it."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, Jul 23, 2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
